title.es: Aquel en el que Pelayo invita a Marta a cenar
title.en: The One Where Pelayo Asks Marta to Dinner

description.es: Marta, Tasio y Damián hablan sobre Eladio. Pelayo le dice a Marta que acepta el trato. Le propone salir a cenar, pero Marta se niega, diciendo que su marido acaba de fallecer.
description.en: Marta, Tasio, and Damián talk about Eladio. Pelayo tells Marta that he accepts the deal. He proposes going out to dinner, but Marta declines, saying that her husband has just passed away.
